design: Compact question set for the $10 total budget: Jev bills input tokens per call, and the question text is resent with every review, so definitions are condensed to short criteria. Full definitions live in labels/taxonomy.json; subtopics are assigned by code (pipeline/extract.py).
state_format: The raw review_text string only. No rating, date, ID or other metadata is sent.

topic.instructions: Main problem in this Spotify review (most severe, else first); if praise, first praised feature.

criteria.playback: won't play, stops, crashes, lag, connection, audio
criteria.catalog: missing songs, search, recommendations, lyrics, podcasts
criteria.billing: price, charges, premium-only limits like shuffle/skips

intent.instructions: Intent; precedence cancellation > complaint > request > praise > unclear.

criteria.cancellation: leaving, uninstalling, cancelling or threatening to

severity.instructions: Problem severity; stars, anger or quitting alone don't raise it.

criteria.1: no problem, praise, unclear, pure request
criteria.5: explicit financial, privacy or data harm

mapping.needs_review: topic or intent confidence below threshold, or non-Latin script
mapping.subtopic: code lexicon within the chosen topic (extract.subtopic)
